item.title: 2.20-ads.1
item.description:
VoiceInk 2.20-ads.1

  • Adds Quick History for faster access to recent transcriptions.
  • Adds Dictionary Auto Learn plus dictionary import and export.
  • Adds mouse shortcuts and improved locked-session shortcut handling.
  • Adds dashboard activity insights and French localization.
  • Improves model downloads, recording cleanup, OpenRouter reliability, and transcription provider support.
  • Preserves the maintained dockless, menu-bar-free workflow, History default, license-free local UI, stable signing identity, and private Sparkle updater.
